purpose: Compare BMI centers and interquartile spreads across the three cohorts. Summaries should lead; keep every supplied participant visible without letting the raw layer obscure quartiles.
mechanism: filled summary boundaries plus adjacent raw lanes
expected_benefit: Filled cohort boxes and strong medians lead; neutral packed raw dots form adjacent lanes without breaking the median or quartile boundaries.
observed_tradeoff: The unequal cohort counts remain fully represented; no density or inferred sample-size area is added.
record_timing: Purpose, roles, actual burden and concrete geometry were planned in create-intent.json, initial spec.json and agent working notes before first rendering; this durable summary was consolidated after bounded image review.
